# Copilot repository guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the single-source documentation map in [README.md](../README.md). Respect assigned paths, interface-first integration, evidence-backed tests and the actual event constraints. No claims of passing tests without observed execution.

Current team scope: **Antenna rescue-first P0 in the already merged MuJoCo runtime**. The existing rover/seed physics, local soil observations and shared/per-rover mapping are meaningful task context, not the primary new algorithm. The immediate integration target is a valid commanded-motion stall → risk-aware recovery/abstain → approved bounded rigid docking/latch/pitch-lift → independently measured extraction, helper safety and resumed fieldwork. **Missing front range alone is not stranded**; regression tests cover that and advisor safety. Scripted latch physics does not prove autonomy. Do not start a parallel Isaac planting-first project, build a winch, use hidden soil truth or label a UI animation a rescue. See [PRODUCT](../docs/PRODUCT.md), [ARCHITECTURE](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [current execution gate](../docs/RUN.md#current-minimum-working-rescue-integration-assignment) and [TESTING](../docs/TESTING.md). Real Isaac hardware remains an unverified optional translation.
